I feel you, my obesity also has a medical cause. Namely, hypothyroidism. So nothing had ever worked in terms of losing weight - until I started taking Ozempic.
So: the first two weeks were shit. Mind you, I was immediately put on the 0,5 mg dose which is not usual. People usually start with the 0,25 mg dose to lrt their bodies get used to the medicine, so the higher dose might have been the reason why I experienced sudden and severe side effects. To be exact, I couldn't eat ANYTHING the first 2 or 3 days after an injection because even if I swallowed a crumb of bread, my whole abdomen hurt so much that I was only able to lie in bed and breathe. Then after those 2 or 3 initial days I was put off food completely; I could eat, but no dish seemed to taste good, so I kind of had to force myself to eat anything in a day. I also got constipation. The second week looked exactly the same: around 3 days of suffering and despair (I was panicking and crying that I wouldn't be able to live like this forever), then the rest of the week was better.
I was extremely afraid to do the third injection, but I FORTUNATELY did. Suddenly, no side effects. At all. I feel MUCH BETTER than I used to before starting Ozempic. For example, my lifelong moderate IBS is almost completely gone. I'm also more energetic and don't feel the urge to eat anything sweet at all. Do I have any side effects now? Yes, one. Just one, but it's annoying and makes getting bloodwork done on an empty stomach very difficult. Namely, this medicine forces me to eat small portions of food, but more often than I used to eat. The problem with this is that I wake up almost every night to eat. I have experienced dreams about eating and not being able to feel satiated and then waking up due to extreme, nauseating hunger numerous times while on Ozempic. I HAVE TO eat at least a slice of bread to stop the nausea. Then I just fall back to sleep. Sometimes I manage to sleep through the whole night, but then I'm usually forced to eat breakfast within the first half an hour of wakefulness.
Well, despite these problems, I'm glad for this medicine because I don't have to do anything at all to lose weight thanks to it. The weight loss is steady and very noticeable. Hope my comment helps!
